abstract: The correlation between tissue localisation and serum levels of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotrophin (HCG) was studied in 20 tissue samples from 18 patients with non-seminomatous testicular tumours. Specific immunoperoxidase stains were used for tissue staining and serum measurements were made by radioimmunoassay. There was a close correlation between the tissue demonstration of AFP and HCG and elevated levels of serum markers. The cellular localisations of AFP and HCG were different and no cell stained concomitantly for both AFP and HCG. From these results and from the demonstration of tumour markers in the tissue of some patients with normal serum marker levels, it was concluded that immunocytochemical localisation of the tumour markers was more sensitive than serum measurements.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の18例、20検体の組織標本を用い、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の組織内局在と血清値の相関を検討した。特異的免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色による組織染色と、ラジオイムノアッセイによる血清測定を行った。組織でのAFPおよびhCG陽性所見は、血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇と密接に相関していた。AFPとhCGの細胞内局在は異なり、両方が同時に陽性となる細胞は認められなかった。血清マーカー値が正常な一部の患者で組織中に腫瘍マーカーが認められたことから、腫瘍マーカーの免疫細胞化学的局在は血清測定より感度が高いと結論された。
